mode.description: The most expensive mode a call may use, and the default: fast, balanced or accurate. balanced when left out.

maxPages.description: The most pages one document may bill. 200 when left out.

extras.description: Datalab extras, comma separated. extract_links,chart_understanding when left out.

pollSeconds.description: How long one call waits for Datalab before it answers pending. Keep it under the tool's timeoutSecs. 40 when left out.

description: The settings the convert tool declares. Its host supplies them, as it does the secrets.
